data.action: 抱粉色灯笼写下分享美食的愿望，将绘马举向镜头
data.description: 【夏日祭神社·黄昏】蜜璃穿着浅绿浴衣抱着粉色灯笼，在绘马架前认真写下“大家一起吃很多好吃的”；她把绘马举向镜头，绿瞳里的愿望比灯火更亮。
data.lighting: pink lantern light beneath the evening sky
data.mood: 恋柱把幸福愿望写给所有人
data.promptProse: At the festival shrine's ema rack, Mitsuri Kanroji writes a wish for everyone to share delicious food, keeping her pink lantern tucked close. She lifts the finished wooden plaque toward the viewer with bright green eyes. Her light-green floral yukata and pink obi remain clear in the horizontal medium view. The lantern casts pink light across her hand and plaque grain, while evening sky light outlines the hanging rows behind.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 祭典灯笼的愿望
